PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 24, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Charles Parkin, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-55893  Recommendation to approve July 10, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-55894  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a Memorandum of
  Understanding, and any subsequent necessary amendments, with California State
  University, Long Beach (CSULB) for the relocation and construction of a 12-inch
  potable water main and associated appurtenances.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-55895  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-12-23 for the 32nd Street Booster
  Pump Station Rehabilitation Project (EO-3501), award a contract to Balfour Beatty
  Infrastructure, Inc., in a total contract amount not to exceed $8,053,000 for a period
  of three years, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-55896  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal to provide Construction
  Management and Inspection Services for the 32nd Street Booster Pump Station
  Rehabilitation Project (EO-3501), award a contract to Butier Engineering Inc., in a
  total amount not to exceed $1,271,948.80 for a period of three years, and
  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into
  the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 24, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55897  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-247 to furnish and deliver four
  backhoe loaders, award a contract to Sonsray Machinery, LLC., in a total
  aggregate amount not to exceed $830,000 for a period of one year, and authorize
  the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the
  contract, including any necessary amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55898  Recommendaton to adopt Resolution No. UT-1542 correcting scrivener’s errors in
  Resolution No. UT-1537, a resolution fixing rates and charges for water and sewer
  services to all customers.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55899  Recommendation to receive and file the FY 25 Business Plan Progress Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:00 AM, Acting President Kevin Scott called the meeting to order.

  Acting President Scott welcomed newly appointed Commissioner Charlie Parkin and shared a brief
 overview of his background, noting Commissioner Parkin previously served the City of Long Beach
 for 38 years before retiring in 2022. He began his career with the City’s Oil Properties Department
 and was later elected City Attorney in 2014. During his time in the City Attorney’s Office,
 Commissioner Parkin also served as Deputy City Attorney for the former Long Beach Water
 Department.

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Leticia Mimila, Capital Projects Coordinator, Utilities Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.
